title: After Dune Delight | Gulf View Seagrove Condo | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: After Dune Delight is a pet-friendly Gulf-view condo in Seagrove with renovated interiors, pools, tennis, and quick access to beach and dining.
description_expanded: After Dune Delight Features - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, and non-shedding. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee per pet is required prior to your arrival. Unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction. - Complimentary Use of 4 backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella - Incredible Gulf views from the living room, balcony, and king suite thanks to the condo's location on the 2nd floor of the building. Stairs available to access the main entrance of the condo. - Fully renovated condo! - Eastern Lake Beach Access is only 1.5 blocks from the condo and is one of the rare areas in the world where a brackish waters flow into the Gulf. You can pick up a fishing license and rent fishing gear at nearby Yellowfin Ocean Sports. Beach service available at this location. This is our recommended beach access. - Shuttle service to Eastern Lake Beach Access mid-March until the end of October from 9am - 5pm. - 90 footsteps to Sugar Dunes beach access. You can walk to the water line at this entrance, but the sand is a private beach for neighboring homes - 4 min bike ride to Walton Dunes Beach Access. Beach service and parking available at this location. - Two Community pools - one is heated during Thanksgiving and Christmas through mid April - Two lighted community tennis/pickleball courts and shuffleboard courts plus cornhole available - Next to Eastern Lake. You get to experience the Gulf or the Lake, depending on which way you face! - Parking for 2 vehicles. RVs, Trailers, and Street parking prohibited. - Full kitchen with high-end appliances, and well stocked for cooking - Bar area next to the living room, with ice maker and beverage fridge - Dining table with seating for 6 plus breakfast bar seating for 2 - In unit laundry area with washer and dryer - Covered balcony with cushioned seating plus high-top table dining for 2. Gorgeous Gulf view! Perfect for sunset viewing. - Concierge services, including grocery deliver and baby equipment rentals available - Golf Cart Rentals only available through Redfish Rentals as the exclusive vendor for this community - Bike rentals available through the neighborhood approved vendor Redfish Rentals - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Come and enjoy an After Dune Delight! Our designer condo features glorious Gulf Views and is footsteps to the sand. Located Southside 30A in Seagrove, Beachside Villas is nestled next to Eastern Lake and is 100 yards to the beach. The community offers resort style amenities including two tennis/pickle ball courts, shuffleboard, and two community pools. One of the pools is heated during winter months. This quieter neighborhood is close to shopping and dining too! Old Florida Fish House, Steamboat Grill, Beachy Bean Coffee Co, Greenway Station, and Buddy's Seafood Market are a 5-minute or less bike ride from the condo. The 30A area is continually growing and evolving. As a result, nearby construction, renovations, or public works projects may occur during your stay. While we strive to provide an exceptional experience, these activities are beyond our control. Refunds or discounts cannot be offered for construction-related noise, disruptions, or changes in views. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: Bunk Area | Twin over Twin Bunk. Built in guard rail and ladder for top bunk, each bunk has a private TV and reading light, hallway access to full bath
Full Guest Bath | combo shower/tub. Hallway access
King Suite | Gulf view from bed, reach in closet, private entrance to balcony, en suite bath
Queen Guest Room | TV, hallway access to full bath

Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
